memory: I confirm Rs=20 Ω remains the preferred resistor and dense via fence + fillets are retained. Sweep 0–3 mm (0.25 mm steps) shows best notch (−26.2 dB) and rise (88 ps) at 0 mm, a small local optimum at 0.75 mm, and steady degradation past 1.25 mm. Shot jitter rises from ~17 ps to ~23 ps at 3 mm. Hypothesis: incremental series inductance and altered coupling to the via fence drive the sensitivity. Current position: keep Rs at pad (0 mm); investigate mechanism of position sensitivity.
openQuestion: Is degradation dominated by added series inductance per mm or reduced capacitive coupling to the via fence? Quantify with TDR and small-step EM.
